revenue.basis: Furukawa Electric official FY2024 financial summary comparative column; consolidated net sales after retroactive accounting-standard application

operatingProfit.basis: Japanese GAAP consolidated operating profit; comparative value in FY2024 financial summary

operatingMargin.basis: Company-reported operating profit margin on sales; Atlas recomputation is consistent within rounding

freeCashFlow.basis: Financial summary provides aggregate operating and investing cash flows but not the exact cash Capex line required for Atlas FCF; FCF is not inferred from total investing cash flow

capex.basis: Exact cash Capex is not isolated in the selected primary financial summary
